**Finding: Compliant (preferred position)** — no redline proposed.

- **Rule:** NOSOLICIT — non-solicitation binding Customer.
- **Result:** The agreement contains no non-solicit, no-poach or no-hire covenant on Northwind. § 12.3 affirmatively confirms Customer "has made no exclusivity, non-compete, most-favoured-customer, minimum-volume, or no-hire commitment" and preserves our freedom to hire anyone responding to general recruitment — better than the fallback and squarely at the playbook's preferred position.
- **Not flagged:** § 12.4 restricts Vendor from developing a competing service; that runs in our favour, so we leave it alone.
